basic_details.short_information: An addendum dated 10 November 2026 from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh (an autonomous institute under MoHFW, Govt. of India) revises the vacancy matrix for Senior Residents / Senior Demonstrators to 45 posts across 24 departments. Applications are submitted by Google Form, with the application forms (Annexure I and II) and supporting documents, by 21 November 2026 (Saturday), 5:00 PM. The fee is Rs. 1500 for General/EWS/OBC and Rs. 1000 for SC/ST; PwBD candidates pay no fee.

content_sections.heading: What the Addendum Changes
content_sections.text: The addendum publishes a REVISED VACANCY MATRIX for the Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator posts. In the matrix, "#" marks new vacancies. The total across all categories is 17 UR, 9 OBC, 9 SC, 5 ST and 5 EWS, which makes 45. The addendum also sets the closing date and the application procedure and fee (below).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The revised matrix lists 45 vacancies in total. The department totals below add up to 45. Reservation: 4% PwBD on a horizontal basis as per Government Rules. The category-wise break-up for each department (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) is in the official addendum.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The qualification for each department, as printed in the revised matrix, is below. Experience is not specified in the addendum. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as on the closing date of application, 21 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: MD/DNB in Anatomy OR (A) M.Sc/M.Biotech Degree in the subject concerned with (B) Ph.D. in the subject concerned/allied subject
MS/ DNB in Surgery OR M.Ch./DrNB (CTVS)
MDS in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery; MDS in Prosthodontics (one post each)
MS in E.N.T. OR MCh (Head & Neck Surgery)
MD/ DNB in Medicine/Paediatrics OR DM/DrNB (Nephrology)
MD/DNB in Pharmacology OR DM (Clinical Pharmacology) OR (a) M.Sc./M.Biotech Degree in the subject concerned, and (b) Ph.D in the subject concerned/allied subject
MD/ DNB in Medicine OR DM/DrNB (Rheumatology)
MD/DNB in Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Geriatric Medicine/ Anesthesiology/Pulmonary Medicine OR MS in Surgery OR M.Ch/DNB (Trauma Surgery)

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator vacancies are there at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: The revised vacancy matrix lists 45 vacancies across 24 departments: 17 UR, 9 OBC, 9 SC, 5 ST and 5 EWS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The closing date is 21 November 2026 (Saturday) by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1500/- for General/EWS/OBC and Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST. PwBD candidates pay no fee. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q4. How is the fee paid?
faq.answer: The fee is paid by NEFT to the account AIIMS MANGALAGIRI – RECEIPTS, SBI, AIIMS Mangalagiri Branch, account number 38321557910, IFSC SBIN0061485.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the application forms (Annexure I and II), then fill out the Google Form and upload the scanned forms, supporting documents and transaction details through the link in the addendum.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply to more than one department?
faq.answer: The addendum refers to candidates applying for more than one department as per the Essential Qualification of the post. They must pay the fee separately for each department.

faq.question: Q7. As on which date are age and qualifications counted?
faq.answer: Age and other qualifications/experience are counted as on the closing date of application, 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What has changed in this addendum?
faq.answer: The addendum, dated 10-11-2026, gives a revised vacancy matrix totalling 45 posts and sets the closing date, application procedure and fee. All other terms of the 29-10-2026 advertisement remain unchanged.
